notes: v1.14.542 — LEGACY-RETIRE STAGE 3.3: THE OMNI-CAPTURE BAR IS DELETED. 158 lines, 6,602 bytes. Out: the #omni-bar markup, its full CSS block including the .omni-inactive triple-belt and the two body.rd overrides, omni_updatePlaceholder, omni_submit, omni_init with its 15-second refresh interval, the boot call, and the mscope caller that reached in to add .omni-inactive. ⛔ omni_getActiveDeployment SURVIVES and this is the whole reason the ship needed reading rather than counting: it has SEVEN callers outside the bar (:23089 and five in the deploy/report stack), acting as the shared 'which deployment is active' resolver. Deleting it with its neighbours would have broken six unrelated surfaces. Same shape as stripeRack_logNote in .540 — the second time in three ships that a shared symbol sat inside a legacy-only module. ⛔ The redesign's replacement was already in place: v1.14.282 moved the LOG composer to #log-sheet, whose CSS is INTERLEAVED with the omni rules (4706–4714 sat between two omni ranges), so the CSS came out as two ranges rather than one block — a single contiguous delete would have taken the redesign's composer with it. logSheet_ and #log-sheet are untouched. 📌 A third dead reserve found and deliberately NOT taken: `.page` reserves calc(--tabnav-h + 140px) where the comment attributes ~60px to the omni bar. That is EVERY legacy page — a far wider blast radius than the five sheets in 3.2b — and body.rd overrides it with --rd-navclear anyway, so the redesign is unaffected. Annotated in place and left for a ship with its own verify. Visible under ?legacy=1 only: the floating LOG bar above the tab nav is gone.
